blurb:
Earlybird Jet Ski Tour – Key West’s Best Deal on the Water

Start your day with adrenaline and savings on our Earlybird Jet Ski Tour, the first trip out on the water and the best value of the day. This exclusive morning tour offers all the thrills of our award-winning 28-mile island ride — at a discounted rate.

Voted Key West’s Best Jet Ski Tour and backed by over 15,000 5-star reviews, this guided adventure takes you around the entire island with scenic stops at the Southernmost Point, a hidden local sandbar, and inside the protected Florida Keys Nature Sanctuary. It’s the perfect mix of speed, sightseeing, and serenity — all before most visitors have finished breakfast.

No hidden fees. No surprise charges. Your tour includes a free second rider, complimentary shuttle pickup (based on availability), and all gear and fuel. Our expert guides ensure a safe, exciting ride while giving you space to explore. Drivers and riders can switch during stops, making it even more fun for both.
